race.description: Michelin Service Centre Warrnambool Mdn Plate
race.comment: FAMMI (10) has the best debut profile, winning trials at Camperdown and Coleraine before starting for Tom Dabernig with Linda Meech aboard. The stable-jockey profile gives him a solid platform and he strikes a winnable affair. HUGHIE'S SPIRIT (2) has the strongest exposed form, with a nose second at Ararat on soft ground before finishing sixth at Ballarat, three lengths behind after a slow start. Sets a decent standard. EMPIRE FELLA (9) also has strong debut claims after two close third-place trial finishes, with John Allen positively booked for the local Raymond & Bell stable. Watch the betting. TYCOONETTE (8) has been off for over a year, but her close second in a recent Burrumbeet trial and a tough fourth in a Sale maiden last time in suggest she could be a live chance if fit for the new yard.
